hebrewText: וַ/אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ וְ/הָ/רָאשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֔/וֹ פָּשְׁט֕וּ וַ/יַּ֣עַמְד֔וּ פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר הָ/עִ֑יר וּ/שְׁנֵ֣י הָֽ/רָאשִׁ֗ים פָּֽשְׁט֛וּ עַֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה וַ/יַּכּֽוּ/ם

tokens.bdb: Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites
the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
tokens.kjv: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, [idiom] every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), [idiom] lead, [idiom] poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
tokens.kjv: accompanying, against, and, as ([idiom] long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with(-al).

tokens.bdb: to spread out (i.e. deploy in hostile array); by analogy, to strip (i.e. unclothe, plunder, flay, etc.)
tokens.kjv: fall upon, flay, invade, make an invasion, pull off, put off, make a road, run upon, rush, set, spoil, spread selves (abroad), strip (off, self).

tokens.bdb: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
tokens.kjv: abide (behind), appoint, arise, cease, confirm, continue, dwell, be employed, endure, establish, leave, make, ordain, be (over), place, (be) present (self), raise up, remain, repair, [phrase] serve, set (forth, over, -tle, up), (make to, make to be at a, with-) stand (by, fast, firm, still, up), (be at a) stay (up), tarry.

tokens.bdb: an opening (literally), i.e. door (gate) or entrance way
tokens.kjv: door, entering (in), entrance (-ry), gate, opening, place.

tokens.bdb: an opening, i.e. door or gate
a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense

tokens.kjv: both, couple, double, second, twain, [phrase] twelfth, [phrase] twelve, [phrase] twenty (sixscore) thousand, twice, two.

tokens.bdb: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
tokens.kjv: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, [idiom] every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), [idiom] lead, [idiom] poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.

tokens.bdb: to spread out (i.e. deploy in hostile array); by analogy, to strip (i.e. unclothe, plunder, flay, etc.)
tokens.kjv: fall upon, flay, invade, make an invasion, pull off, put off, make a road, run upon, rush, set, spoil, spread selves (abroad), strip (off, self).

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.kjv: country, field, ground, land, soil, [idiom] wild.

tokens.bdb: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), [idiom] go forward, [idiom] indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, [idiom] surely, wound.
